observations: Literal script, CSS URL and HTML/Markdown delimiters remain visible source, not live behavior.
Desktop and 390px source/reader captures are readable; source wraps and inert badges remain visible.
Filled empty source stays in its own code carrier.
WebKit density/font fallback differs; this is not pixel equality across engines.
Code-keyboard contract captures show visible focus and horizontal code overflow; surrounding debug JSON is a test harness, not the public mobile UI.
limitations: Desktop engine emulation, not physical mobile or native IME coverage.
Safe source fallback, not reproduction of original HTML layout/behavior.
Selected recorded workflows, not every editor interaction or third-party clipboard destination.
